source.title: Constructing a creative self-efficacy inventory: A mixed methods inquiry
source.author: Daniel H. Abbott

scope: Original claims and source limitations; not computational verdicts or current-status literature review.

claims.question: What is the latent structure of creative self-efficacy?
claims.original_claim: Revised CTSE/CPSE model has adequate psychometric support after three residual covariances are added.
claims.limitation: Rounded covariance reconstruction is not FIML/MLR empirical rerun.

claims.question: Is the tested general-factor rival preferred?
claims.original_claim: No general factor of creative self-efficacy; refined Revised model preferred.
claims.limitation: Implemented rival fixes higher-order CTSE and CPSE variances and covariance to1: perfect correlation, not all general-factor formulations.

claims.question: Does creative self-efficacy relate to BCSE?
claims.original_claim: All creative self-efficacy factors correlate with BCSE.

claims.question: Does creative self-efficacy relate to openness?
claims.original_claim: All creative self-efficacy factors correlate with openness.

claims.question: Do changes improve on theoretically justified models?
claims.original_claim: Revised preferred over All and Held by AIC.

claims.question: Do changes improve on empirically justified models?
claims.original_claim: Revised preferred over Implied Structure and Implied Indicators by AIC.
claims.limitation: Hypothesis wording no worse p66, better p124; consistent operational rule lower AIC.

claims.question: What sample was used?
claims.original_claim: 308 respondents;297 complete;Table3.2 says296.
claims.limitation: Table3.2 sample discrepancy unresolved, not silently harmonized.

claims.question: What estimator handled missing responses?
claims.original_claim: FIML with MLR robust corrections in Mplus.
claims.limitation: Requires response patterns and higher moments; single rounded correlation matrix insufficient.

claims.question: Is n200 sufficient under the specified simulation?
claims.original_claim: Reported selected empirical power simulation supports n200.
claims.limitation: Full generating code and all residual variances not supplied in AppendixI.

claims.question: Who was interviewed?
claims.original_claim: Eight interviewees from33approached;two per high/low CTSE/CPSE group.

claims.question: How do interviews contextualize the model?
claims.original_claim: dark feelings reported for low CTSE.
claims.limitation: Original interpretation retained; no empirical interview/coding replication. Prompt wording differs for internal blocking.
